summary: Part 1 (00:00-03:57 in the pack) of the "1.0 Onboarding App (KAM)" training. Pierre introduces the four parts of seller onboarding (Inbound, Outbound, Seller view, Admin view) and then walks through the seller side of Inbound: a seller finds the Revibe For Businesses page, clicks Become a seller, fills the public Become Official Revibe Seller form, uploads a trade licence, is redirected to the AppSheet "Revibe - Seller Onboarding App", watches the intro video, and starts the Users Form. The narration ends at 03:54 with the form still open; the Save step and the Admin view are not in this part. All 40 pack frames were opened and checked against the screen. Several pack frame citations were wrong and have been corrected (see audit.corrected). Frame-to-timestamp matching for the AppSheet form is inferred from narration order (see unclear).

screens.name: AppSheet: Users Form (side panel)
screens.shows: Seller onboarding form: Introduction text, First name, Last name, Email (greyed), Company name (as mentioned in your trading licence), Country, Phone, Emirate, exact shipping address, Google map location, products, B2B, online sales and platforms, units per month, grades, as is/refurbished/both, technicians, daily order capacity, how did you hear, know anyone, comments, Seller agreement, Application status, Approval; Cancel and Save buttons.

terms.meaning: The AppSheet app 'Revibe - Seller Onboarding App' where sellers who want to join as official partners complete the onboarding form. Shown on the Sellers' journey slide as the first onboarding step (legal clearance, Revibe T&Cs, quality guidelines).
Onboarding part 1: sellers who come to Revibe on their own (narration: 'sellers coming to us').
Onboarding part 2: sellers the KAM reaches out to in order to recruit them on Revibe.
Onboarding part 3: what sellers see and must do in the onboarding app.
Onboarding part 4: how to process seller applications (named only, not covered in part 1).
Onboarding step after the app; the slide says 'Send 20/30 pieces to our lab'.
Outcomes of quality check on the slide: Onboarded if quality is good; Rejected if quality is not good.
Journey stage on the slide: set prices for direct shipping.
Journey stage on the slide: set prices and quantities for fulfilment shipping.
Journey stage on the slide with Dashboard, Get access to all apps, and Get access to all trainings.

Heading 'RENEWED ELECTRONICS' on the For Businesses page (the website banner also says 'Like new, but waaaay cheaper'). Implied: Revibe's term for its refurbished electronics. The 'What is Renewed from Revibe?' link was not opened in this part.
Website navigation item; the trainer says it is mainly for corporates buying in bulk. It also holds the Become a seller button.
Upload field on the public seller form; marked required, 'Supported format: PDF'.
Required field on the public seller form and a dropdown in the Users Form, in bands from 0 - 100 to > 10,000.
Choice of whether the seller sells devices as is, refurbishes them, or both.
Application status chip shown on the form. Implied: it shows the application is not yet finished.
Form item with a status button; it shows 'To do' before the seller completes it. The meaning of 'To do' is implied by the label.
Dropdown at the bottom of the Users Form; it is empty in this part and its options are not shown.

unclear.issue: Frame-to-timestamp matching for the AppSheet form (t00148 to t00234) is inferred from narration order and from the frame images. Several pack citations gave the wrong frame for a claim (corrected in audit.corrected). Verify timestamps before relying on exact seconds.
The Quality check box on the slide reads 'Send 20/30 pieces to our lab'. The narration does not explain it, so it is unclear whether the number is 20 or 30 pieces or a range.

The Google map location field is pre-filled with https://www.google.com/maps/ and the trainer pasted a maps.app.goo.gl link after it, giving a doubled prefix. The narration does not say which format the seller should enter.

The trainer uploads a file named 'Atlassian_Inv...' (invoice-like) as the trade licence and says 'let's upload something'. The form asks for a trade licence and states 'Supported format: PDF'. It is unclear whether an invoice is acceptable.
The narration says the email is 'automatically the one recorded by Google', but the field is greyed and it is not clear whether the seller can edit it.
The narration says 'if they say no it's okay' about knowing anyone who sells at Revibe. It is unclear whether a No answer has any effect on the application.
The part ends before Save is clicked, so it is not shown what Save does, what the Seller agreement 'To do' button opens, or what happens to Application status after Save.

The narration says the seller 'will get access to some info and will have to complete a first form' before the public form. It is not clear whether this is one form or the public form plus the Users Form.

outdated.signal: The app says onboarding may take a few weeks because of a high number of applications. This is time-bound and may no longer be true.
Slide footer reads '© 2024' (the word 'Copyright' is partly hidden by the webcam overlay), so the Sellers' journey material may predate the current site and app.

privacy.what: The public seller form shows a named individual (Pierre Villaceque) with an email address (pierre.villaceque@gmail.com), a partial phone number (+971 0544637) and a business name (PEPE TRading). Frames t00096, t00103. This is the presenter's demo data, but it is still personal data and should not be shown to sellers.
The Users Form shows a named individual's work email (pierre@revibe.me) and the name Pierre Villaceque. Frames t00148, t00151, t00154.

Address autocomplete popups list named people and street addresses from earlier entries, including 'Pierre - District One - Residence 27', 'Pierre - Ontario Tower Office 103', 'Pierre - 123 AVENUE JOSEPH DURAND...', and 'chez Delphine Raspadori 123 Avenue Joseph Durandy'. The last one identifies a named individual with a street address. Frames t00151, t00154, t00159.

The business address 'Ontario Tower - Business Bay - Dubai - United Arab Emirates' and a Google Maps short link (maps.app.goo.gl/vKLVWFGbAziU6f...) are shown in the form. This is a business location, but it is tied to a real seller record. Frames t00182, t00195.
